title: Search brain cell data for research leads with many agents
summary: OpenAI, PerturbAI and Scripps Research say they used thousands of AI agents to find promising research leads in data from millions of brain cells.
agent_role: Thousands of distributed agents analyzed the biological data to surface leads; the human role is not described in the provided text.
outcome: OpenAI reports the agents uncovered promising research leads.
what_they_did: OpenAI worked with PerturbAI and Scripps Research. They ran thousands of AI agents in parallel over data from millions of brain cells to look for new research leads.
how_it_went: OpenAI says the effort turned up promising leads; the summary gives no numbers.
